we have proposed and implemented a novel method to find causal patterns in observational data and have used the framework to find the effect of cholesterol lowering drugs on T2DM.

we have proposed and implemented a novel framework for causal pattern discovery and causal association rule mining.
we developed an efficient framework to extract causal patterns from observational data and applied it to a challenging real world data set.

The main takeaway from our work is that

the proposed methods are able to extract causal patterns from EHR data that are not extractable by existing methods, and that these patterns can be used to explain the controversial effects of drugs and treatments on diseases.
the causal rules extracted from EHR data are sufficiently rich and accurate to explain the effect of a drug on a condition, even in the presence of multiple confounding factors.
